sources.entry: REI3 - Manage tasks, time, assets and much more within your business. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Go

summary.one_liner: REI3 is a free, open source low-code platform for building and self-hosting multi-user business applications, written in Go with a PostgreSQL database.
summary.what_it_does: REI3 lets you build custom multi-user applications (replacing spreadsheet-based solutions) and host them on your own servers, on-premise or in the cloud. Its feature list covers record summaries and date calculations, business rules, Gantt charts, diagrams, and lists, plus workflows that change forms by record state and export to PDF or send notifications. Access control uses roles and access policies that can apply globally or per record. The README also mentions built-in end-to-end encryption, full-text search, MFA and password policies, REST endpoints, CSV import/export, ICS calendar feeds, LDAP user management, and a PWA-friendly mobile interface. Data is stored in PostgreSQL in human-readable form.
use_cases: replace spreadsheets with multi-user business apps
task and project management with Gantt charts
asset and record tracking with access policies
generating PDF documents and notifications from records
how_to_run: Extract the REI3 package (x64/arm64) to a location such as /opt/rei3 and run chmod u+x r3
Copy config_template.json to config.json and point it at an empty UTF8 Postgres database
Optionally install ImageMagick and Ghostscript for thumbnails, and postgresql-client for integrated backups
Start the service with sudo systemctl start rei3
Default login is admin/admin on port 443; Docker Compose files and a Windows installer are also provided
notable: Low-code application builder that is self-hosted and open source
Built-in end-to-end encryption with key management
Integrated backups via PostgreSQL client tools
Human-readable database that can be read and edited directly
Four-digit versioning scheme with separate branches per minor release
caveats: Requires a PostgreSQL database and a service manager or Docker for production setup
Proxies must have websocket client timeouts disabled
Default admin credentials (admin/admin) must be changed after setup
REI3 is a registered trademark; third-party releases or extensions require contacting the maintainers
keywords: run business software on my own server
